title: Space Bulletin Daily – Wednesday, October 14, 2026
description: NASA says work on the rocket for Artemis Three has reached another milestone. According to the agency, teams at Kennedy Space Center in Florida have finished stacking the final solid rocket booster segments on the mobile launcher, and all four RS-25 engines are now installed on the core stage. NASA plans to roll the partial rocket out to Launch Pad 39B in the coming months for a fueling test.
